e.body:
**Agentic Actuarial Testbed**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22821486`，版本 `v1.0`）**是一个**把**「**误差传播**」**与**「**操作风险资本**」**放进 **agentic** 精算**工作流**的**仿真**测试台****——**逐字自述**（**描述**全文**只有 **100** 个**字符）**为**「**Simulation testbed for error propagation and operational risk capital in agentic actuarial workflows**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储元数据聚合面**：用 **DataCite／**Dataverse／**Crossref** 找单仓储检索**漏掉的**窗口内**工件**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-20 Zenodo 与 GitHub 接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**「**误差传播**」**与**「**操作风险资本**」**放进**同一句**，**而**这**正是**把 **AI** 工作流**接进**精算**与**监管**语言**的**接口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**记录**描述**逐字**仅一句**（**全文 **100** 字符）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一句**值得**单独**记**：**⭐ 即**多**智能体**流水线**（**draft → **审阅 → **再**决策**）**的**误差**会**沿**链**条**累积**，**而**「**累积**到**什么**程度**需要**多少**资本**」**是**一个**可以**定量**的**问题**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**当**有人**问**「**AI** 出错**的**代价**怎么**算**」**时**，**这**就是**可**引用**的**框架**；**⭐ 但**本词条**只**记**其**自述**，**不**主张**其**方法**正确**。
**⭐⭐ ② 描述**只有**一句**，**没有**方法**章节**——**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**可**安装**」**与**「**可**理解**」**是**两件**事**：**⭐ 读者**想**知道**它**如何**度量**误差**、**误差**如何**转成**资本**、**测试台**的**环境**是**什么**，**只能**去**读**代码**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引用**这类**新**工件**时**，**把**「**我**读**了**代码**」**与**「**我**读**了**描述**」**分**开**写**；**⭐ 本词条**只**做到**后者**。
**⭐⭐ ③ ⚠️ 配套**数据集 **3.42 GiB** 却**没有**描述****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**同**一位**作者**在**同一**天**（**2026-09-18）**发布**的 **`Agentic actuarial workflows Dataset`**（**`10.5281/zenodo.22821051`**，**类型 **`dataset`**，**许可 **`cc-by-4.0`**，**创建者逐字 **`ADETOLA, ADEBAYO ALIU`**）**的**文件**逐字**为 **`Data_Act.zip` **3,673,234,501 B**，**而**其 **`description`** 字段**在**接口**里**为**空**（**本次**实测**为 **`undefined`）**，**相关**标识**也**为**空**数组**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**提示**：**⭐ 即**「**数据集**」**三**个字**不**告诉**读者**它**是**什么**——**⭐ 下载**前**要**先**看**文件**量级**与**描述**是否**匹配**（**⭐ 本词条**未**下载**，**故**不**评价**其**内容**）**。
**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 外部**验证**为零**，**且**版本**记录**成**对**出现****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**GitHub **`tollyboy88/agentic-actuarial-risk-testbed`** 逐字**为 **★0、**许可 **MIT、**主**语言 **TypeScript、**仓库 **5,011 KB、**创建 **2026-09-04、**末次**推送 **2026-09-18**；**⭐ 而 **Zenodo** 侧**同**一**工件**有**两**个 **DOI****（**`10.5281/zenodo.22821485` 经 **HTTP 302** 重定向到 **`10.5281/zenodo.22821486`**）**——**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**引用**时**要**写**最新**版本** DOI**，**而 **`10.5281/zenodo.22821485`** 是**同一**记录的**版本**重定向**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**⭐ 0 星**意味**着**没有**第三方**用过**它**，**这**不**使**它**无用**，**但**意味**着**它**的**正确性**要**由**读者**自己**验**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 许可**与**可**再**分发**（**含**附件**侧**）**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**软件**记录**许可**逐字 **`mit-license`**、**访问**逐字 **`open`****；**⭐ 配套**数据集**许可**逐字 **`cc-by-4.0`****——**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**两**个**工件**的**许可**不同**（**MIT** 与 **CC BY 4.0）**，**引用**与**再**分发**时**要**分别**标注**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[ai-agents-for-insurance-guide]] 覆盖**保险**业 **AI** 智能体**落地**指南**、**[[agentic-bop-underwriting]] 覆盖**代理式**小型**商业**险**核保**、**[[actuarial-skills]] 覆盖**精算**技能**封装**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**误差**传播**与**操作**风险**资本**做**成**仿真**测试台**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **误差**传播**与**资本**计量**可以**写进**同一句**；**② **「**可**安装**」**≠**「**可**理解」**，**引用**时**要**说明**读**到**哪**一层**；**③ **数据集**有**多大**不**等于**有**多**可**用**，**先**看**描述**；**④ **同一**工件**的**多**个 **DOI** 要**辨**清**版本**重定向**；**⑤ **软件**与**数据**的**许可**可能**不同**，**分别**标注**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**其 **zip**、**未**安装**或**运行**其**测试台**、**未**读**其**任何**代码**，**故**不**主张**其**可**运行**性**、**方法**正确**性**或**输出**可信度**。**② ⚠️ **未下载**其**配套**数据集 **3.42 GiB**（**故**不**主张**其**内容**、**行**数**、**字段**与**质量）**。**③ ⚠️ 其**描述**只**有**一句**，**本词条**的**技术**定位**全部**来自**该**句**，**未**做**独立**判断**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与 **GitHub** 仓库**的**内容**是否**一致**（**只**核对**了 **`isSupplementTo`** 与**版本**标签**存在）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未**核实**其**是否**有**论文**、**文档**或**示例**（**本次**只**见**一句**描述**与**一个 **zip）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**发布日 **2026-09-18** 在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**本轮**基准日 **2026-09-20）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑦ ⚠️ **★0** 为 **2026-09-20** 快照**，**会**变化**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-20 所见**；**⚠️ 涉及**AI** 工作流**的**误差**与**资本**计量**，**⚠️ 用于**真实**定价**或**资本**计算**前**须**独立**验证**。

e.summary_en: This is a simulation testbed that places error propagation and operational risk capital inside agentic actuarial workflows, and its entire written description is that single sentence of about one hundred characters. **Measured this round**: published on the eighteenth of September inside the window, typed as software, MIT licensed, openly accessible, credited to one author, shipped as a versioned archive of roughly three and a half megabytes, and linked by a supplement relation to a matching tag on a source repository. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregators, using an index that spans repositories to find in-window artefacts that single-repository probing missed, and it was found through such an index rather than through the repository-specific path used last round.** **Four things are worth reading: it puts error propagation and operational risk capital in the same sentence, which is the interface through which a multi-agent pipeline is connected to actuarial and regulatory language, since downstream errors accumulate and the consequence is held by capital; the description is one sentence with no method section, so installable and understandable are two different things and anyone who wants to know how error is measured has to read the code; the companion dataset is three and a half gigabytes with no description field at all, published the same day by the same author under an attribution licence, so its contents, row count, and fields cannot be judged from the record; and external validation is zero, with no stars, a single language, and a creation date in early September followed by a push in the window, which means it is a freshly published artefact with no third-party trace yet.** **No archive was downloaded, the testbed was not run, and no data content was read this round.**

e.body_en:
This is a simulation testbed that places error propagation and operational risk capital inside agentic actuarial workflows, and its entire written description is the single sentence that says so. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregators, using an index that spans repositories to find in-window artefacts that single-repository probing missed.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-20 from the Zenodo and repository interfaces**:
**First, it puts error propagation and operational risk capital in the same sentence, and that is precisely the interface through which an AI workflow is connected to actuarial and regulatory language.** The record carries a one-sentence description of about one hundred characters, and the sentence is worth recording on its own because errors in a multi-agent pipeline accumulate along the chain, while how much capital is needed for a given accumulation is a question that can be quantified. **For this programme it is a citable frame when someone asks how the cost of AI error should be calculated, though this entry records only what the artefact says about itself and makes no claim that the method is correct.**
**Second, the description is one sentence with no method section.** Installable and understandable are therefore two different things: anyone who wants to know how error is measured, how it converts into capital, or what the testbed environment is must read the code. **When citing this kind of fresh artefact, keep the statement that the code was read separate from the statement that the description was read, and this entry claims only the latter.**
**Third, the companion dataset is three and a half gigabytes and carries no description.** The same author published an Agentic actuarial workflows Dataset on the same day under an attribution licence, whose single file is a large archive, while its description field comes back empty from the interface along with an empty list of related identifiers. **The word dataset does not tell a reader what is inside, so before downloading, compare the file magnitude against the description, and here there is nothing to compare against. No file was downloaded, so nothing is claimed about its contents.**
**Fourth, external validation is zero and the version record appears in pairs.** The source repository shows no stars, an MIT licence, a single language, a repository of about five megabytes, creation in early September, and a push inside the window, while the archival record has two identifiers, one of which redirects to the other, so a citation should name the current version and treat the older identifier as a version redirect. **No stars means no third party has used it yet, which does not make it useless but does mean its correctness is for the reader to establish.**
**Fifth, the licences and redistribution terms differ between the two halves.** The software record is MIT licensed and openly accessible, while the companion dataset is under an attribution licence, so citation and redistribution should label the two separately.
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a guide to AI agents in insurance, agentic small-commercial underwriting, and packaged actuarial skills, **while this entry supplies the form of a simulation testbed for error propagation and operational risk capital. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: error propagation and capital measurement can be written into one sentence; installable is not the same as understandable, so say which layer was read; a large dataset is not automatically a usable one, so read the description first; distinguish multiple identifiers for one artefact from genuine versions; and check whether software and data carry different licences.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no archive was downloaded, the testbed was neither installed nor run, and no code was read**, so no claim is made about runnability, methodological correctness, or the credibility of its output. **Second, the three and a half gigabyte companion dataset was not downloaded**, so nothing is claimed about its contents, rows, fields, or quality. **Third, its description is one sentence and this entry takes its technical positioning entirely from that sentence** rather than from an independent judgement. **Fourth, whether the repository contents match the archival record was not verified**, only the existence of the supplement relation and the version tag. **Fifth, whether a paper, documentation, or examples exist was not verified**, only one sentence and one archive being visible. **Sixth, the publication date falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twentieth of September. Seventh, the star count is a snapshot from that date and will change. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-20 and states plainly that using such a workflow for real pricing or capital calculation requires independent validation.**
